column1: # Golden expectation for Track 2 drug triage on the synthetic mechanism.
# Changing this file requires a decision record (GP-32) and a matching update to
# the hash lock in tests/golden/test_locked_files.py, in the SAME commit.
# SYNTH-DRUG-E was re-baselined from accepted to rejected by ADR 0011: an
# unassessed chromosomal-instability risk is disqualifying for a disease-modifying
# agent in this disease context. SYNTH-DRUG-G was added at the same time to keep
# the "direction undetermined is not disagreement" lesson (ASSUMPTION-DRUG-02),
# which E had been the only carrier of.
